# apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_order (Resource)

Sets the order of the leaderboards in a Game Center leaderboard set. The list replaces the set's leaderboards, so name the same ones as the set's `apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member` resources. App Store Connect has no way to remove an order, so destroying the resource leaves the items as they are. Import it with `set/<leaderboard_set_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_order" "seasons" {
  leaderboard_set_id = apple_game_center_leaderboard_set.seasons.id
  leaderboard_ids = [
    apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member.weekly.leaderboard_id,
    apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member.high_scores.leaderboard_id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `leaderboard_ids` (List of String) App Store Connect IDs of every leaderboard in the set, in order; refer to the member resources' `leaderboard_id`.
- `leaderboard_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The owner's kind and App Store Connect ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_order.seasons
  identity = {
    id = "set/6b8d0f2a-4c1e-4a3b-8d5f-9e0a1b2c3d4f"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The owner's kind and App Store Connect ID, e.g. `set/<id>`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_order.seasons set/6b8d0f2a-4c1e-4a3b-8d5f-9e0a1b2c3d4f
```
